description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayEnvironment module in a Swift project. It tests functionality related to semantic version parsing, version string normalization, version compatibility, gateway port configuration, and version extraction from strings.

methods.name: semver parses common forms
methods.description: Tests the parsing of various semantic version strings, including those with prefixes, suffixes, and invalid formats.

methods.name: gateway version output strips product prefix before parsing
methods.description: Verifies that an output string from the gateway has its product prefix stripped before parsing as a semantic version.

methods.name: semver compatibility requires same major and not older
methods.description: Checks if specific semantic versions are considered compatible based on major and minor versions.

methods.name: gateway port defaults and respects override
methods.description: Tests the default gateway port value and that user overrides from UserDefaults are respected.

methods.name: expected gateway version from string uses parser
methods.description: Ensures that version strings are correctly parsed into Semver objects, including handling nil inputs.
